Description: Lack of MFA for privileged accounts (A.9.2.3)
Mitigation: Implement MFA for all privileged users

Description: No incident response plan so breaches are contained slowly (A.16.1.1)
Mitigation: Approve and test an incident response plan with named roles

Description: No periodic review of user access rights (A.9.2.5)
Mitigation: Run quarterly access reviews with manager sign-off

Description: Open vulnerabilities are not tracked to closure (A.12.6.1)
Mitigation: Track findings in a ticket system with owners and due dates

Description: Backups never restore-tested so data may be unrecoverable (A.12.3.1)
Mitigation: Perform quarterly restore tests and record the results

Description: No central log review so attacks go undetected (A.12.4.1)
Mitigation: Centralize logs and review alerts weekly

Description: Information is not classified so sensitive data is poorly protected (A.8.2.1)
Mitigation: Define a classification scheme and label customer data

Description: No secure coding standard leads to vulnerable applications (A.14.2.1)
Mitigation: Adopt a secure coding standard and add code review checks
Make training mandatory and track completion to 100%

Description: Suppliers are not held to security requirements (A.15.1.1)
Mitigation: Add security clauses to all vendor contracts

Description: Changes made without formal approval cause outages (A.12.1.2)
Mitigation: Add an approval step to the change ticket workflow
Run an annual continuity exercise and update the plan
